status_effects.explanation: His narrated tragic decline (deafness, dependency) diminishes his standing relative to the vigorous, royal-adjacent figure evoked in the same breath.
His grandiloquent remark is gently mocked as excessive by the duchesse and Bréauté, mildly undercutting his rhetorical standing in the scene, though the mockery is affectionate rather than hostile.
